jobs.occupation: Senior Internal Communications & Project Support Officer
jobs.description:
📋 Tasks and responsibilities

To support the Global Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) team during a temporary absence, we are looking for a Project & Communication Support Officer who will provide broad operational, administrative, and coordination support across several global EHS initiatives.

This role combines project support, stakeholder coordination, communication activities, event organization, and administrative follow-up. You will work with internal and external stakeholders and help ensure the smooth delivery of international EHS programs.

Scope of the role

You will contribute to a range of strategic initiatives, with a strong focus on flexibility in task content. The assignment includes leading both larger and smaller projects or events, supporting other project managers, and providing overall administrative assistance. A hands-on approach is essential.

Examples of ongoing initiatives

• Global Safety Commitment Day
• Coordinate a global awareness and engagement campaign for employees worldwide.
• Liaise with external and internal training providers, translation agencies, and communication teams.
• Support the preparation of communication materials, presentations, and stakeholder updates.
• Coordinate deliverables and follow up with multiple international stakeholders.
• EHS Awards Program
• Coordinate the full awards process, from submission intake through jury review to leadership presentations.
• Organize and support the logistics of the awards event.
• Coordinate suppliers, purchasing activities, and event-related follow-up.
• Ensure smooth communication with all stakeholders involved.
• Support budget follow-up and administrative activities linked to the EHS department.
Primary responsibilities

• Provide communication and project coordination support across multiple global EHS initiatives and engagement campaigns.
• Independently draft, prepare, and review internal communications, announcements, presentations, and stakeholder materials to a professional standard.
• Support awareness and engagement campaigns while ensuring clear and consistent messaging.
• Coordinate with external suppliers, training partners, translation agencies, and internal teams to ensure timely and accurate delivery of content.
• Prepare stakeholder updates, management presentations, and campaign-related materials.
• Organize meetings, prepare agendas, capture actions, and follow up on commitments.
• Coordinate project planning, timelines, actions, and deliverables for assigned initiatives.
• Monitor progress and proactively follow up with stakeholders.
• Support the organization of global events and engagement activities, including logistics.
• Maintain project documentation and reporting tools.
• Send reminders and ensure action follow-up through email and Microsoft Teams.
• Provide general administrative and operational support, including budget follow-up, purchase requests, and invoice tracking.

• Proven hands-on experience as an Internal Communications Officer or in a similar communication-focused role.
• At least 3 years of relevant experience in internal communications.
• A relevant educational background in communication, marketing, journalism, public relations, or a related field; a Master's degree in a closely related domain is also suitable.
• Experience working in an international and multicultural environment.
• Experience preparing professional presentations and communication materials.
• Experience in project coordination and organizational or administrative support.
• Budget tracking and administrative support experience is a strong asset.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Excellent organizational and planning abilities.
• Hands-on mindset, with the flexibility to combine administrative work and coordination tasks.
• Detail-oriented, proactive, and able to manage multiple priorities effectively.
• Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
• Collaborative team player, comfortable interacting with stakeholders at different levels.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, and Outlook.
• Fluent in Dutch and English, with the ability to prepare presentations and communication materials in both languages with a high degree of accuracy.
• Conversational French for daily interaction in the Brussels office.

We are looking for loaders - unloaders for a leading logistics company specializing in the efficient transportation of goods.

This is an on-call position, where you will be deployed as needed, providing flexibility in your schedule.
This means we can also be flexible for you (for example, if there are certain days you cannot work, we can keep this in mind).

You'll work in a 2 shift system.
One week you'll work from 5h (morning) until 13h (afternoon)
The other week you'll work from 13h (afternoon) until 21h (evening)
- Vaardigheden:
You are flexible
You are able to do physical work 
You can work well in a team
You have your own transportation to get to work on these hours (bike, car, step,..)

- Talenkennis:
English

Our client is a major player in the logistics sector. They handle road transport, air freight, and sea freight.

The Antwerp branch is responsible for everything related to ocean freight. Around 100 employees work there and give their best every day to provide the highest possible level of service. They are seated in groups of four colleagues at work islands, spread over two floors. The atmosphere on the work floor is calm—sometimes hectic—but very pleasant. There is strong teamwork, and there is certainly room for regular laughter as well.

Every two weeks, a fruit basket is delivered to the departments. In addition, you can work with flexible hours, there are various opportunities for personal development, and subscriptions for the toll tunnel and the water bus are fully reimbursed.

In short: a very attractive employer!

Jobomschrijving

Are you detail-oriented and passionate about data, pricing, and ocean freight? 

As a Rate Management Specialist, you’ll play a key role in ensuring accurate and efficient pricing processes that power our global operations.

You’ll manage customer contracts, tariffs, and costing data across our systems, enabling seamless auto-rating and auto-costing and supporting our journey toward full digitalization.

Working closely with commercial, operational, and system teams, you will help deliver tailored pricing solutions that meet customer requirements while supporting ongoing digitalization and process improvement initiatives. This position is essential in maintaining data integrity and optimizing the performance of our global rating platforms.

	
• Strong attention to detail and analytical mindset	
• Experience in Ocean Freight pricing or operations (minimum 2 years)	
• Strong communication and collaboration skills	
• Proficiency in Microsoft 365	
• Fluent English and Dutch
